research_question: How do the verified GSE157504 transcript context and Abruzzi et al. (2017) S3 author-reported cycler calls align with the current candidate channels across s-LNv, l-LNv, LNd and DN, without changing candidate scores or electrophysiology gates?
hypothesis: A source-scoped sidecar can make published transcript-cycling context visible alongside the existing GSE detection/rhythm and literature/electrophysiology evidence while retaining pooled-cell scope and score invariants.
alternative_hypotheses: The PLOS S3 candidate set may differ from the existing GSE context candidate set; non-overlapping candidates must remain explicit rather than being silently added or dropped.
PLOS LNv, LNd and DN1 groups may not resolve the requested subtype-level targets and therefore cannot be assigned as direct subtype-specific transcript evidence.
Some candidates may not be listed under the authors' HC/LC criteria; list omission is not evidence of absent expression or biological arrhythmicity.
Published transcript-cycling calls may not predict channel protein abundance, native channel current, membrane-potential rhythm, or causal behavioral function.
preparation: Read-only join of an already verified GSE157504 transcript-context sidecar and an already verified Abruzzi et al. (2017) S3 published cycler audit; no new assay, normalization or rhythm fit.
cell_type: s-LNv, l-LNv, LNd and DN targets cross-referenced to pooled PDF-positive LNv, LNd plus fifth PDF-negative s-LNv, and a DN1 subset.
experimental_unit: Candidate-by-target context row; not a biological replicate. Source GSE cells remain nested within source samples, and published S3 records derive from pooled neuron libraries.
primary_readout: Source-scoped author-reported HC/LC/not-listed status and exact S3 row references appended to each existing candidate-by-target context row.
secondary_readouts: Candidate-set differences between the GSE context and published-cycle audit.
Verbatim preservation of all existing GSE context columns, including literature scores and electrophysiology/shortlist gates.
Current validation and isolated replay of both source chains and the combined sidecar.
time_system: GSE157504 labels remain LD/ZT or DD/CT; Abruzzi et al. S3 calls are from LD time courses with author-reported ZT. No conversion or new rhythm analysis is performed.
required_metadata: Candidate symbol and target group from the base context table.
Current parent-manifest validation and isolated-replay status, manifest IDs and SHA-256 values for both source chains.
Exact candidate symbol, source worksheet group, HC/LC flags and source row numbers from the S3 audit.
Source group scope mapping and the distinction between not listed, absent from the audit candidate set, and unmapped target group.
Base literature score, score coverage, ephys-directness score/gate, shortlist gate and readout, preserved verbatim.
analysis_plan: Revalidate both parent public-data manifests against current files and require their stored isolated replays to verify the exact required output hashes. Cross-check the PLOS audit CSV against its candidate_summary and HC/LC flag classes. Apply only the explicit source-group crosswalk: pooled LNv to both s-LNv/l-LNv context rows without subtype resolution; LNd-plus-fifth-PDF-negative-s-LNv to LNd with the mixed scope note; DN1 subset to DN with the subset limit. Append source-call status and row provenance without recomputing or modifying any base context field. Validate the new composite manifest and replay it in an isolated mirror.
decision_gate: Verify only if the parent chains currently pass, the PLOS table and report agree row-for-row, each input candidate/target key remains unique, all original context columns are byte-value equivalent in the output, the expected scope limits and missing/not-listed distinctions remain explicit, synthetic invalid cases fail closed, and manifest validation plus isolated replay reproduce both outputs.
acceptance_tests: Synthetic crosswalk tests map mixed LNv calls to both LNv target rows while explicitly leaving subtype unresolved, preserve LNd and DN1 scope limits, and distinguish HC, LC, not-listed, absent-from-audit, and unmapped statuses.
Synthetic conflicting duplicate source rows are not silently collapsed into a single HC or LC call.
An unverified parent manifest/replay, mismatched audit CSV/report, duplicate context key, or output/input collision is rejected.
Real output retains one row per existing candidate-by-target row and copies every base context field, score, and gate unchanged.
The real PLOS LNv 249-versus-252 manuscript/S3 discrepancy is carried forward, not reconciled by the join.
The composite manifest validates, and isolated replay reproduces the context CSV and report hashes.

verification.focused_tests: 6 published-cycle context tests and 5 replay-gate tests passed, including synthetic crosswalk/missingness/conflict cases, parent replay blocking, collision safety, duplicate-context-key rejection and a real-data replay.
verification.real_data_join: 15 candidates x 4 target groups produced 60 rows. Six distinct candidate-by-source-group PLOS calls (six source rows across five candidates) expanded to nine target-row annotations because the pooled LNv calls appear on both s-LNv and l-LNv rows; 2 mapped HC target rows, 7 LC target rows and 51 not-listed target rows.
verification.score_invariants: All 32 base context fields, including every literature score, coverage, ephys-directness field, shortlist gate and readout, were copied verbatim; no score or ephys gate was recomputed.
verification.candidate_set_difference: The GSE context and PLOS audit each cover the same 15 literature candidates. The base GSE context's existing literature-only na and GSE-only eag difference remains unchanged.
verification.source_scope_and_discrepancy: PLOS LNv remains pooled s-/l-LNv, LNd includes the fifth PDF-negative s-LNv, and DN1 is a subset. The manuscript LNv HC total 249 versus S3 252 discrepancy remains unresolved.
verification.parent_chains: Both source manifests were revalidated against current hashes; each parent's stored isolated replay verified the exact CSV and report outputs.
verification.isolated_replay: verified_public_dataset_replay; 1 run; both context CSV and JSON report hashes reproduced; zero issues.
verification.scientific_status: Verified as a source-scoped, deterministic descriptive transcript-context join only; it is not evidence of channel protein/current rhythm or causal behavioral function.

limitations: The PLOS publication profiles mixed LNv, mixed LNd-plus-fifth-PDF-negative-s-LNv, and a DN1 subset; these data do not distinguish requested target subtypes or cover all DN.
The source lists are transcript-level author classifications. No new expression normalization, rhythm fit, current measurement, protein assay or behavior experiment is conducted.
No exact symbol entry under the author criteria means not listed in the selected supplement, not absent or arrhythmic.
The PLOS manuscript-versus-S3 LNv HC-count discrepancy remains unresolved and is carried forward unchanged.
The composite join is descriptive context only and cannot change the candidate ranking or establish channel-mediated membrane-potential rhythms.
